name: F770
summary: Large-format FDM for long parts, fixtures and full-size prototypes.

page.description: Stratasys F770 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Industrial-scale printing.
page.lead: A 1,000 × 610 × 610 mm fully heated chamber, which Stratasys says is the widest in the X direction on the market†, for full-size prototypes, long fixtures and one-piece parts, with soluble support and remote monitoring.
page.footnote: * or ±0.002 mm/mm, whichever is greater. † Stratasys claim (T25: up to 2.3×). Source: stratasys.com F770 page, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: Big parts without the big-machine complexity.

features.title: Three layer resolutions
features.text: Plus adaptive slice height for speed or detail.

features.title: Fully heated chamber
features.text: The widest in the X direction on the market (Stratasys claim).

features.title: Soluble support
features.text: No design-for-manufacturability limits on complex parts.

features.title: Remote monitoring
features.text: Built-in camera with GrabCAD Print and Insight.

benefits.title: Industrial capability
benefits.text: A large build chamber for big parts.

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: XY ±0.254 mm or ±0.002 mm/mm; Z ±0.200 mm or ±0.002 mm/mm, plus 1 layer height (whichever is greater, 95 % dimensional yield)

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print, GrabCAD Print Pro, Insight, Control Center, MTConnect enabled

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE, cTUVus, RCM, EAC, FCC Part B

page.applications_text: Long prototypes, large fixtures and parts that would otherwise be printed in sections and bonded.
